name: stutter
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; LAB_CASE=3 LAB_PIN_CASE=1 LAB_PIN_FRAMES=1 LAB_SATURATE=1 LAB_NO_UNITS=1 LAB_FRAME_COUNTS=1 LAB_AT_POINT=1 LAB_CASE_REFINE=1 LAB_FOCUS_COLD=1 bun research/track-m/count-case-replay.ts replay-input/overlap.json replay-input/input.json

name: all
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; for f in overlap quorum; do LAB_PIN_CASE=1 LAB_PIN_FRAMES=1 LAB_SATURATE=1 LAB_NO_UNITS=1 LAB_ALL_MODELS=1 LAB_FRAME_COUNTS=1 LAB_AT_POINT=1 LAB_CASE_REFINE=1 LAB_FOCUS_COLD=1 bun research/track-m/count-case-replay.ts replay-input/$f.json replay-input/input.json; done
